claims.predicate: Closed source translation accounts for every statement of Admission reserve/release and initial ownership; actual capacity operator, owner mutation, count delta and lane selector generate the Lean executable.

From empty ownership, every serial lock-linearized reserve/release trace preserves active = owner cardinality, distinct owners and active <= selected lane limit; duplicate and rejected reservations do not acquire ownership.

Exact-owner release is idempotent, cannot remove another owner, and removes exactly one reservation when owned. Anonymous allocation uses a fresh owner and anonymous release uses the last anonymous owner, or no-op.

Reservation precedes thread allocation and registration precedes attempted start. The reaper skips current-thread and already-uncertain entries. It marks an owned registered entry uncertain before either join(timeout=0) or is_alive. RuntimeError retains that mark and continues; every other observation exception propagates with the mark retained. Only normal return from both observations clears the mark. A normally observed live thread retains ownership; only a normally observed terminated thread may be removed and released. Uncertain entries are never observed or reclaimed again before process restart.

The successful main startup topology has one public listener and zero or one literal-loopback control listener with equal normalized default profiles. Disabled control has zero handlers and no diagnostic availability claim. Enabled lanes have disjoint ownership, locks and credits; component bounds imply the combined cap, burst and rate sums.
Actual paired sockets demonstrate public saturation and independent enabled loopback health ingress, refusal before allocation, and release after normal and exceptional handler paths.

At the serialized listener callback cut there is at most one accepted-but-unreserved socket per listener, at most two in the enabled topology. Kernel backlogs are separate; accepted-before-reserve does not count as a handler reservation.
Every declaration and theorem in the admission Lean modules has an empty transitive axiom set, including no propext, sorryAx or Classical.choice.

The augmented owner ledger includes prethread reservations and registered native threads. Its cardinality equals active reservations inductively; concrete registered and potentially live threads remain bounded. Uncertain owners form a subset of registered owners and therefore remain bounded by the same selected lane cap. A reachable-history reliability relation is established from clean initial metadata: observation begins only for a previously reliable owner, failed join or liveness observation makes that owner permanently uncertain, and no subsequent apparently successful observation can restore it. Reclamation requires a complete successful observation begun from reliable history, not a free clean-state premise.

failurePolicy: Any unsupported syntax, unmatched mutation, missing mapping, failed theorem, negative control escape or witness failure is BLOCKED.

representation.owners: List of injectively named live socket/object identities, with distinctness invariant; order is unobservable in the Python set.
representation.active: Natural number representation of Python exact integers on reachable nonnegative states; mutations are separately related to exact integer arithmetic.
representation.credits: Credit gates can nondeterministically refuse but cannot acquire or release ownership. Detailed refill and total admissions-over-time belong to TRF02.
representation.concurrency: Python lock linearizes the admitted reserve/release critical sections; no arbitrary external mutation of admission state.
representation.threads: Phases distinguish attempted, identified-but-not-started, running and dead. CPython join/is_alive may corrupt status bookkeeping when interrupted; a later false is_alive is not trustworthy after an earlier failed observation. Each registered owner has an observation state: reliable, observation-in-progress, or sticky uncertain. The concrete uncertain-owner set represents in-progress and sticky uncertain states. Only normal completion of both observations restores reliability; failure never does. Current-thread entries are skipped before marking. Successful normal completion clears the marker before optional dead-entry removal and exact-owner release.
representation.observationBookkeeping: The marked observation transaction covers exceptions at the join/is_alive primitive boundaries. Lock-serialized CPython set/dict/count bookkeeping transitions are atomic model actions; this contract does not prove arbitrary asynchronous cancellation between every bookkeeping bytecode. Source order and the declared atomic primitive interpretation remain explicit correspondence obligations.

CPython Thread.start/bootstrap and the normal-return semantics of join/is_alive for an owner with an uninterrupted reliable observation history. Any exception from either observation may invalidate later liveness metadata; the model permits this invalidation and the implementation quarantines the owner. No promise that a later successful join repairs metadata is trusted.
excluded: Kernel backlog equals advertised listen argument on every OS
Recovery of capacity quarantined after any join/is_alive exception; each retained uncertain slot is bounded and requires process restart to recover.
Arbitrary asynchronous cancellation between the separately modeled set/dict/count bookkeeping actions; observation-primitive exceptions are included and must preserve the uncertainty mark.
refinementReason: Constructed local native status-lock interruption makes CPython Thread liveness bookkeeping unreliable while the handler remains alive. Durable uncertainty is specified and frozen before production repair.

observationPolicy.initial: Every newly registered owner starts reliable; the uncertain set is empty.
observationPolicy.skip: If request is already uncertain or its thread is threading.current_thread(), continue without invoking join or is_alive.
observationPolicy.begin: Add the registered request owner to the uncertain set before invoking join(timeout=0).
observationPolicy.observe: Invoke join(timeout=0), then is_alive(), within the same try block.
observationPolicy.runtimeError: Continue without clearing the uncertain marker, releasing ownership, or querying that owner again.
observationPolicy.otherException: Propagate without clearing the marker or releasing ownership. Future reapers skip this owner.
observationPolicy.normalReturn: Remove the marker only after both calls return normally, then remove/release only if the returned alive value is false.
observationPolicy.boundedness: The uncertain set contains only registered reservation owners; marking cannot create an owner or increase the active reservation count.
observationPolicy.recovery: An owner with a failed observation remains uncertain for the process lifetime; restart creates a new empty ledger.
